sqlmodel: SQLModel: the package root a session, a model base and the statement constructors are imported from, and this pack's name
Session: SQLModel: the unit of work a query runs inside, re-exported from SQLAlchemy
AsyncSession: SQLModel: the async unit of work, with the same methods
Select: SQLModel: what its select() comes back as when it picks whole rows
SelectOfScalar: SQLModel: what its select() comes back as when it picks one column or one model
Update: SQLModel: the update() construct re-exported from SQLAlchemy
Delete: SQLModel: the delete() construct re-exported from SQLAlchemy
Insert: SQLModel: the insert() construct re-exported from SQLAlchemy
update: SQLModel: the construct that changes matched rows
delete: SQLModel: the construct that removes matched rows, and the Session method that removes one object
insert: SQLModel: the construct that adds rows
select: SQLModel: the function that builds a SELECT, imported at the call site
add: SQLModel: the Session method that stages a new object
add_all: SQLModel: the Session method that stages several
merge: SQLModel: the Session method that writes detached state back
flush: SQLModel: the Session method that sends staged work to the database without committing
commit: SQLModel: the Session method that makes staged work permanent
bulk_save_objects: SQLModel: the Session method that writes a list of objects in bulk
bulk_insert_mappings: SQLModel: the Session method that inserts rows from a list of dicts
bulk_update_mappings: SQLModel: the Session method that updates rows from a list of dicts
exec: SQLModel: the Session method that runs a statement built by select() and the like
execute: SQLModel: the SQLAlchemy Session method that runs a statement, still reachable
scalars: SQLModel: the Session method that runs a statement and returns its first column
scalar: SQLModel: the Session method that runs a statement and returns one value
begin: SQLModel: the Session method that opens a transaction
rollback: SQLModel: the Session method that discards staged work
close: SQLModel: the Session method that ends the session
expire: SQLModel: the Session method that marks an object's attributes stale
expire_all: SQLModel: the Session method that marks every loaded object stale
expunge: SQLModel: the Session method that detaches an object
expunge_all: SQLModel: the Session method that detaches every object
values: SQLModel: the statement method that supplies column values
text: SQLModel: the function that wraps a statement the project wrote as SQL, re-exported from SQLAlchemy
SQLModel: SQLModel: the base a model is written under, `class User(SQLModel, table=True)`
Relationship: SQLModel: the constructor a model's field is given to reach another model, `items: list[Item] = Relationship()`
